proposed_comments.title: Queue drag publication before releasing the state lock
proposed_comments.body:
### Queue drag publication before releasing the state lock

**Severity:** `high`

The current drag/drop state transition reserves a pending publication while holding `DragActivationLock`, but queues the actual `ClipboardDragDrop` / `ClipboardDragDropOperation` notification only after that lock is released. A mouse-hook transition can therefore run `ChangeDropMachine` in between and enqueue `End(old) / Begin(new)` ahead of the original `Begin(old)`, leaving a destination stuck in dropping state or causing the final release to target the wrong machine. Please enqueue each drag publication while holding the same lock that mutates the publication state, while keeping the network send itself on the existing asynchronous queue.
